description: Register (or update with endpoint_id) an https webhook endpoint for the events you pick (needs webhooks:write): order.paid, order.confirmed, order.shipped, order.delivered, order.cancelled, refund.requested, refund.verified, dispute.opened, catalog.rejected, merchant.key_rotated. The URL must resolve to public addresses only. A new endpoint returns its whsec_ signing secret ONCE. Deliveries are signed (X-APIbase-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=HMAC-SHA256(secret, t.body)); dedupe by order_id. Another merchant's endpoint_id is 404.
name: shop.merchant.webhook_set
title: Set a webhook endpoint
